title: Prompt-agnostic Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.37683v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Despite their strong performance, large language models remain highly sensitive to prompt formulation. This issue is typically addressed at inference-time through manual prompt optimization, which introduces overhead and lacks scalability. Conversely, we focus on train-time approaches that build prompt robustness into the model during instruction tuning. A common strategy is to mix multiple paraphrases of each prompt into training. We demonstrate that across trainable parameters, the per-paraphrasing gradients interfere, with 57% exhibiting sign conflicts and the naive gradient average discarding approximately a fifth of the magnitude. Therefore, we develop two gradient-merging methods, Prompt-TIES and Prompt-DARE, that address this interference by leveraging interference-resolution operators from model and gradient merging and applying them to prompt gradients. translated_abstract: 尽管大型语言模型性能强大，但它们对提示的表述方式仍然高度敏感。这一问题通常在推理阶段通过人工提示优化来解决，但这会引入额外开销且缺乏可扩展性。与此相反，我们专注于训练时方法，即在指令微调过程中将提示鲁棒性内建于模型之中。一种常见的策略是将每个提示的多个改写版本混合到训练数据中。我们证明，在可训练参数上，不同改写版本的梯度会相互干扰，其中57%的参数存在符号冲突，而朴素的梯度平均会丢弃约五分之一的梯度幅度。因此，我们开发了两种梯度合并方法——Prompt-TIES和Prompt-DARE，它们利用来自模型合并和梯度合并领域的干扰解决算子，并将其应用于提示梯度，从而化解这种干扰。在本研究中，我们比较了这些方法在提升模型鲁棒性方面的效果……
tldr: 该论文发现指令微调中不同提示改写版本的梯度存在严重干扰（57%存在符号冲突），并提出Prompt-TIES和Prompt-DARE两种梯度合并方法，在训练阶段将提示鲁棒性内建于模型，从而摆脱对推理时人工提示优化的依赖。
en_tdlr: The paper identifies severe gradient interference among prompt paraphrases during instruction tuning (57% sign conflicts) and proposes two gradient-merging methods, Prompt-TIES and Prompt-DARE, to build prompt robustness into models at train-time without inference-time prompt optimization.
